summary: Desktop model picker: the search field keeps focus while Up and Down move the highlighted row and Enter picks it (a listbox with aria-activedescendant); search ranks prefixes, then word starts, then substrings, then subsequences from 3 characters, by src/shared/model-search.ts; Default shows only with no query; the body below the tabs is a fixed 300 px for every tab and query. The composer chip shows the short model name (shortModelLabel in src/shared/models.ts, also written to tests/fixtures/model-catalog.json as `short`); its title keeps the full id. The Expo settings chip shows the same short name. Contrast: picker avatar initials take black or white by the accent, --text-muted is darker in light and lighter in dark so it reads at 4.5:1 on raised surfaces, and every picker control has a hover state. The Hub chip and hubChipText read 'Hub · n children'.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Compose new-session sheet lists full model labels and has no model chip or search. Its catalog copy is checked against id, label and tier only; the new `short` field in the shared fixture does not change that check.

updateRelease.reason: An unconditional client UI change with no flag, package identity, signing, update-channel or rollout change. The Expo change ships on the normal OTA lane.

automated: npx vitest run tests/unit/model-search.test.ts tests/unit/provider-picker-models.test.ts tests/unit/model-catalog-fixture.test.ts tests/unit/raised-surface-contrast.test.ts tests/unit/toolbar.test.ts tests/unit/hub-client-view.test.ts
